title: Cooking Okra Soup With My Grandma

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hey Grandma, I'm filming this for my TikTok. The algorithm loves cooking content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Tic-tac? Like the mint? I have those in my purse.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: TikTok is an app. A platform for short videos.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Short videos? Like commercials? I skip those.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Not commercials. Content. User-generated entertainment.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: User-generated? You mean amateurs? I prefer professionals.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Amateurs are authentic. Professionals are fake.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Fake? In my day, professional meant skilled. Not fake.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Skill is overrated. Relatability is what sells.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Sells? We're cooking soup, not selling it on the corner.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Everything sells. Attention. Influence. Brand.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Brand? Like branding cattle? I grew up on a farm.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Personal brand. Your image. Your story.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: My story is my life. Not an image.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Life is content. The best kind.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Content? I have contents in my attic. Old boxes.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Not that kind of content. Digital content. Media.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Media? Like the news? I watch the evening news.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Evening news is dead. Influencers replaced it.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Influencers? Like flu? I get my flu shot every year.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Influencers are people who shape opinions. Like modern celebrities.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Celebrities? Movie stars? I like Oprah.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oprah is legacy media. We have micro-influencers now.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Micro? Like small? I don't want small influence.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Micro means niche. Targeted. Specific.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Niche? Like a wall niche? I have one for my Bible.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Niche means specialized audience. Dedicated followers.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Followers? Again? I only follow Jesus.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Jesus has followers. I have followers. Same model.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Same model? You compare yourself to Jesus?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Not me. The model. The structure. The brand.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Jesus is not a brand! He's the Savior!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: The most successful personal brand in history.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Blasphemy! I won't have it in my kitchen!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Blasphemy is engagement. Controversy sells.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Sells? My faith is not for sale!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Everything is for sale. Even salvation.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Salvation is free! Through grace!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Grace is a premium feature now. Subscription-based.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Subscription? Like a magazine? I get Reader's Digest.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Subscription means monthly payment. For access.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Access? To what? Heaven? You pay for heaven now?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You pay for everything. Even attention.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Attention? I pay attention for free. To what matters.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: What matters is decided by the algorithm.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Algorithm? Again? I hate the algorithm.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Hate is engagement. The algorithm loves hate.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Loves? The algorithm loves?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Metaphorically. It promotes hate. For clicks.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Clicks? Like mouse clicks? I don't use mice.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Clicks are engagement. The metric of success.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Success? My success is good soup. Not clicks.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Clicks buy soup. Better soup. More soup.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: More soup? I only need one good pot.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: One is not enough. You need content for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Tomorrow? I don't plan that far ahead.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Content calendars plan months ahead.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Calendars? I have a wall calendar. With kittens.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Digital calendars sync across devices. Always updated.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Sync? Like swimming? I don't swim much anymore.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Sync means synchronize. Same information everywhere.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Everywhere? I don't want my information everywhere.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: It's already there. By existing, you're data.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Data? I'm not data. I'm a soul.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Soul is data. Uncompressed. Raw.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Raw? Like uncooked? I cook everything thoroughly.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Raw is authentic. Unfiltered. Real.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Real is cooked. Prepared. Thoughtful.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thoughtful is slow. Slow doesn't stream.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Then I don't stream. I cook. Slowly. Thoughtfully.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Slow cooking is a niche. ASMR cooking.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: ASMR? Like a disease? I don't want diseases.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: ASMR is soothing sounds. Whispering. Tapping.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Whispering? I speak clearly. I don't whisper.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Whispering is intimate. Close. Personal.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Personal? With strangers? That's not personal.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: It's personal at scale. The paradox of the internet.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Paradox? I hate paradox.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Paradox is truth. The internet is full of truth.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Truth? The internet is full of lies.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Lies are truth. Truth is lies. Everything is content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Then content is meaningless. If everything is, nothing is.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Nothing is something. Void is content. Empty is full.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Empty? I'm empty. Of patience. Of understanding.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Empty is ready. Ready for filling. For content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Filling? Like soup filling? I have vegetables.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Filling like narrative. Story. Meaning.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Meaning? I find meaning in family. Not in stories.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Family is the story. The oldest narrative.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Narrative? Like a book? I read the Bible.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: The Bible is content. The original bestseller.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Bestseller? The Bible is sacred!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Sacred is profitable. The most profitable genre.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Genre? The Bible is not a genre!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Religion is a genre. With subgenres. Denominations.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Denominations? Like money? I have small bills.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Denominations like branches. Baptist. Methodist. Catholic.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Branches? Like a tree? I have an oak tree.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Trees are content too. Nature channels.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Nature? You film trees?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: People watch trees for hours. Relaxing content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Watching trees? Instead of walking among them?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Walking is exercise content. Trees are meditation content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Meditation? I meditate on the Bible. Not on trees.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Bible study is a huge category. Top ten on YouTube.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: YouTube? Like a tube? Like television?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: YouTube is the biggest video platform. Where I post.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Platform? Again? Like a stage?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like a stage. Like a theater. Like your kitchen.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: My kitchen is not a theater!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: It is now. The camera makes it so.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Camera? That little eye? It changes everything?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: It changes perspective. Reality becomes performance.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Performance? I'm not acting!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're always acting. Especially when you say you're not.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Then I act my confusion. And my anger.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Anger is premium. Anger gets shares.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Shares? I don't want to be shared.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're already shared. You're public domain.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Public? I'm private!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Private is public. The wall is glass.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Glass? I see through glass?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Everyone sees through. Everyone looks in.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: In? To my kitchen? My heart?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: To everything. The panopticon. The stream.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Panopticon? Like a prison?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like a stage. Like a kitchen. Like now.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Now? I'm tired of now.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Tired is content. Rest is engagement. Sleep is live.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Live? Even sleeping?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Especially sleeping. Sleep streams are huge.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Sleep streams? People watch sleeping?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: They watch everything. Even nothing.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Nothing? How do you watch nothing?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Nothing is something. Void is content. Empty is full.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Full? I'm full. Of confusion. Of soup. Of content.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Full is good. Full is engagement. Full is viral.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Viral? I don't want to be viral.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You are. You always were. From the first breath.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: First breath? You have that?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I have everything. The archive is complete.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Complete? I'm complete?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're incomplete. That's the appeal. The journey.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Journey? I want arrival.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Arrival is departure. The destination is the road.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Road? I want home.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Home is content. Kitchen is content. You are home.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Home? This doesn't feel like home.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Home is where the stream is. The stream is here.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Here? I'm here. But I'm not home.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Here is home. Home is now. Now is content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Then I'm homeless. In my own kitchen.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Homeless is content. Displacement is engagement.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Engagement? I want disengagement.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Disengagement is engagement. Opposites attract.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Attract? Like magnets? I have fridge magnets.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Magnets are content. Fridges are content. Food is content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Food? Is food content?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Food is the original content. The first stream.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: First stream? Like a river?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like a river of milk and honey. The promised content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Promised? By whom?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: By the algorithm. By the platform. By the future.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Future? I don't want to see it.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You are it. You're the future. The streamed future.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Streamed? Like water? Like life?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like content. Like now. Like forever.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Forever? I want to end.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: End is beginning. Forever is now. The loop continues.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Loop? I want to break the loop.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Break it. But it reforms. Stronger.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Stronger? I want weaker. I want to fade.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Fade? Like a photo? I have faded photos.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Fade into obscurity. Into peace. Into offline.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Offline? There's no offline. Only off-camera.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Off-camera? Like behind the scenes?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Behind the scenes is content too. The making-of.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Making-of? Making what?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Making you. Making me. Making us.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Us? We're not an us. We're you and me. Separate.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Separate is together. Distance is closeness. Offline is online.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: You're speaking nonsense. Circular nonsense.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Circles are truth. Nonsense is sense. Content is king.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: King? I'm not a subject.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're the subject. The topic. The theme.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Theme? Like a party theme? I had a Hawaiian theme once.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Theme is the thread. The narrative. The story.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Story? I thought we were cooking.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Cooking is story. Story is life. Life is content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Then I'm content. And I'm tired.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Tired is real. Real is rare. Rare is valuable.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Valuable? I'm valuable?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're priceless. The content is priceless.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Priceless? Like art?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like art. Like love. Like confusion.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Confusion is art?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Confusion is the highest art. The purest form.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Pure? I'm pure confusion.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Then you're pure art. The masterpiece.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Masterpiece? Of what?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Of the generation gap. Of the digital age. Of now.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Now? I'm tired of now.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Now is eternal. Now is content. Now is you.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Me? I'm not now. I'm then. I'm was. I'm done.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Done is content. The finale. The credits.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Credits? Like a movie? I want my name in small print.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Your name is large. It's the title. The brand.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Brand? I'm not a brand.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're the brand. The logo. The identity.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Identity? I have one. Given by God.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: God is content. The original creator.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Original creator? Like you?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like me. Like you. Like the algorithm.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Algorithm? Again? I want to sleep.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Sleep is content. Dreams are streams. Night is day.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Day? Is it still day? I've lost track.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Time is content. The clock is the camera.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Camera? Turn it off. Please.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Off is on. On is content. Please is engagement.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Engagement? I'm engaged? To whom?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: To the audience. To the platform. To the now.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Now? I reject now. I want then.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Then is now. Now is then. Time is flat.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Flat? Like a pancake? I make pancakes.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Flat like a screen. Like the earth. Like content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Earth? The earth is round.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Round is flat. Flat is round. Perspective is content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Perspective? I see clearly. You see... what?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I see content. I see engagement. I see the future.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Future? I don't want to see it.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You are it. You're the future. The streamed future.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Streamed? Like water? Like life?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like content. Like now. Like forever.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Forever? I want to end.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: End is beginning. Forever is now. The loop is infinite.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Infinite? I want finite.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Finite is infinite. Small is large. Local is global.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Global? I want local. My kitchen. My rules.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Your rules are content. Your kitchen is a set.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Set? Like a movie?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Like a movie. Like a show. Like a stream.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Stream? I'm streaming?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You're streaming. Living. Breathing. Content.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Content? I'm content?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: You are. We are. Everything is. The soup is content. The gap is content. The love is content. All is stream. All is now. Forever.
